title: CWP/34408/2024 of BALBIR SINGH Vs UNION OF INDIA AND OTHERS
text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH 116 CWP-34408-2024 Date of Decision : February 06, 2025 BALBIR SINGH -PETITIONER V/S UNION OF INDIA AND OTHERS -RESPONDENTS CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP TIWARI Present: Ms./Mrs. Veena Kumari, Advocate for the petitioner. KULDEEP TIWARI, J. (ORAL)

1. The grievance propelling the petitioner to institute the instant writ petition stems from his representation, wherein becomes enclosed prayer for grant of compensation on account of demise of his minor daughter in an acid attack, remaining yet undecided by the respondent(s) concerned.

2. Taking into account the innocuous and bona fide prayer of the petitioner, this Court deems it appropriate to, without going into the merits of the instant writ petition, direct the respondent No.3- Punjab State Legal Service Authority to make a final decision on the petitioner’s representation (Annexure P-12) within a month from today, but, after giving opportunity to the petitioner to substantiate his claim, as made before this Court.

3. Disposed of accordingly.

4. A copy of this order be forthwith sent to the respondent No.3 for information and compliance. (KULDEEP TIWARI) February 06, 2025 JUDGE devinder authenticity of this order/judgment
